data.name: Jeemaat
data.gender_notes: Jeemaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Jamaa’ah’, which means ‘a community or group of believers’. This name represents the idea of coming together in faith and unity. In Islamic history, the term ‘Jamaa’ah’ was used to refer to the collective body of Muslims, united in their beliefs and practices. The name Jeemaat carries the meaning “Gathering, Community” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jeemaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gathering, community and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing people together in faith and unity
data.etymology: Jeemaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gathering, Community.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeemaat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
